name: Munroa

project_scope.scope: Existing canonical species only; no new admission

look_here_first: FLUFFGRASS: very low, spreading, often hairy starburst clusters in dry gravel; pale long-hairy leaf and sheathing parts make it appear fluffy or silvery. Photograph an intact stem with its actual densely bundled flowering spikelets and inspect glumes, sterile and fertile lemmas under magnification. Not a typical tall prairie bunch grass.
